_meta.description: SEA Change Intelligence Dashboard — processed country registry for pipeline and frontend

fields.name: Official English name
fields.world_bank_code: World Bank API country code — use in /v2/country/{code}/indicator/...
fields.dashboard_priority: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low' — controls default visibility and chart order
fields.default_selected: true = included in default dashboard view on first load
fields.notes: Analyst context relevant to the dashboard

priority_logic.high: Core SEA countries with full indicator data, or top-2 partner economies (China, US)
priority_logic.medium: Large SEA economies or countries with active alerts, or mid-tier partners
priority_logic.low: Small/data-sparse SEA countries, or lower-impact partners

countries.name: Thailand
countries.notes: Upper-middle income. Key auto hub. EEC FDI zone. Political risk from recurring military interventions. Tourism-reliant services sector.

countries.name: Vietnam
countries.notes: Fast-growing FDI magnet for electronics supply chains. Large US trade surplus creates tariff risk. EVFTA with EU in force.

countries.name: Singapore
countries.notes: City-state hub. World's largest FDI per capita. Re-export centre distorts trade statistics. MAS uses exchange rate band as primary monetary tool.

countries.name: Indonesia
countries.notes: Largest ASEAN economy. Commodity-export dependent. Capital relocation to Nusantara ongoing. Key nickel and palm oil producer.

countries.name: Malaysia
countries.notes: Semiconductor cluster in Penang attracting major US chip investment. Ringgit volatility tied to commodity prices. ASEAN Chair 2025.

countries.name: Philippines
countries.notes: Large diaspora remittance inflows support consumption. Growing BPO sector. Typhoon risk creates periodic GDP shocks. South China Sea tensions.

countries.name: Myanmar
countries.notes: POST-COUP CRISIS (Feb 2021). GDP contracted. Hyperinflation, currency collapse, FDI exit. Post-2021 statistics from IMF estimates only.

countries.name: Cambodia
countries.notes: Garment-dependent economy. EU GSP preference pressure. High current-account deficit. Highly dollarised — limited independent monetary policy.

countries.name: Laos
countries.notes: DEBT DISTRESS: Government debt >100% GDP. Kip lost >50% vs USD since 2021. IMF-flagged for restructuring. China-Laos Railway opened 2021.

countries.name: Brunei
countries.notes: Micro oil-state. High GDP per capita. Economy entirely dependent on hydrocarbons. BND pegged 1:1 to SGD. Very limited World Bank data.

countries.name: Timor-Leste
countries.notes: ASEAN candidate. Uses USD — no independent monetary policy. Petroleum Fund is primary fiscal resource. WB code TP (legacy East Timor identifier).

countries.name: China
countries.notes: Largest trade partner for all SEA countries. BRI funder. Property crisis ongoing. US-China tech decoupling driving supply chain shifts to SEA.

countries.name: United States
countries.notes: Key export destination for VNM, THA, MYS. Primary source of tariff risk. Fed rate decisions affect SEA currency pressure.

countries.name: Japan
countries.notes: Major FDI source for THA (auto), VNM (electronics). Yen weakness reduces FDI purchasing power. CPTPP founding member.

countries.name: India
countries.notes: Rising regional power. Act East policy deepens ASEAN ties. Competing manufacturing FDI destination vs SEA.

countries.name: South Korea
countries.notes: Major FDI source for VNM (Samsung ~20% of Vietnam exports), IDN, THA. Korea-ASEAN FTA active.

countries.name: Australia
countries.notes: Key ASEAN dialogue partner. CPTPP and RCEP member. Commodity exports relevant to SEA industrialisation. Australia-ASEAN Comprehensive Strategic Partnership.

countries.name: European Union
countries.notes: BLOC (27 member states). GSP/EBA preferences critical for KHM, MMR, LAO garment exports. EVFTA with VNM active. CBAM affects IDN, MYS commodity exporters.
